title: Second Coming
definition: The second coming is the promised visible return of Jesus Christ in glory to judge, reign, raise the dead, and bring God’s redemptive purposes to completion.
summary: Christian hope is not vague optimism. It rests on the sure promise that the risen Christ will return, evil will be judged, and His people will be gathered to Him.
christFocus: The returning Christ is the believer’s blessed hope. His coming calls us to watchfulness, holiness, endurance, and mission.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Christ’s return will be personal, visible, and glorious.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: The timing is in the Father’s authority, so believers watch faithfully.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Hope in His return strengthens endurance and holiness.
